detailZh: 梅赛德斯解释为何一年多前放弃马卡雷纳尾翼
梅赛德斯副技术总监西蒙娜·雷斯塔透露，车队一年多前就评估过旋转式尾翼概念
致梅赛德斯车迷：来自银箭的最新消息，包括F1新闻、车手动态、赛车研发以及来自布拉克利和布里克斯沃思的赛事分析。
梅赛德斯F1车队早在竞争对手将其投入赛道使用之前，就研究过自建马卡雷纳尾翼。但据副技术总监西蒙娜·雷斯塔表示，车队最终决定不采用。
这种旋转翼——当赛车切换至直线模式时，其主翼片会翻转——在当前这一规则时代已成为非常显眼的创新。法拉利最先采用这一想法，并被称为“玛卡arena翼”，红牛也在迈阿密带来了自己的版本。迈凯伦——我们已看到其在测试自己的版本——表示将在未来某个时候让其一战。
梅赛德斯是四大车队中唯一尚未对此类设计表现出兴趣的车队。如今，雷斯塔在车队自己的最新一期《银箭电台秀》节目中解释了原因。
“我大概要说一些我们之前没有分享过的事情：大约一年多以前，我们的绘图板上就有这种翼了，”雷斯塔说。“我们一直在相当详细地评估这个概念，它显然在降低阻力方面带来了好处，但在你操作开缝模式（Open SM）的每一节练习与排位中，也会带来下压力的减少。
“这是我们评估过的东西。这是我们从未觉得在平衡上是最佳整体折衷方案的东西，可以说，所以值得在研发以及制造部件等方面进行投入。但这并不意味着同样的结论永远有效，我们可能会在今后重新审视我们的观点和立场。
“所以我们当然保持谦逊，逐一检查现有的所有方案，评估是否有任何对我们有价值、值得采纳的东西，并让这个迭代过程持续下去。”
梅赛德斯到目前为止在没有该尾翼的情况下依然应对自如。车队以578分领跑车队积分榜，领先法拉利134分；进入美国大奖赛比赛周时，安东内利领先队友拉塞尔102分。
不过，重点是在此前于新加坡站将升级分配给两位车手之后，把新升级带到两辆车上。安东内利使用了新升级，而拉塞尔测试了旧版本。车队领队托托·沃尔夫此后确认，新部件将在美国站出现在两辆车上。
detailEn: Mercedes reveals why it rejected the Macarena wing over a year ago
Mercedes deputy technical director Simone Resta reveals the team evaluated the rotating rear wing concept more than a year ago
For Mercedes fans. All the latest from the Silver Arrows, with F1 news, driver updates, car development and race analysis from Brackley and Brixworth.

The Mercedes Formula 1 team looked at building its own Macarena rear wing long before it was seen running on a circuit by a rival outfit. But according to deputy technical director Simone Resta, it decided against it.

The rotating wing, whose main flap turns over when a car switches into straight-line mode, has become a very visible innovation so far in this current era of regulation. Ferrari was first to run the idea with it being coined the Macarena wing, and Red Bull brought its own version to Miami. McLaren, who we have seen testing its own, has said it will race one at some point in the future.
Mercedes is the only one of the top four teams yet to show an interest in such a design. Now, Resta has explained why on the latest episode of the team's own Nu Silver Arrows Radio Show.

"I am probably going to say something we have not shared before: we had this kind of wing on our drawing board a bit more than a year ago," Resta said. "We've been evaluating this concept quite in detail and it's clearly offering a benefit in drag reduction, but it's also coming with a reduction of downforce in every session you operate the Open SM.

"And it's something that we evaluated it. It's something that we never felt in balance to be the best overall compromise, let's say, so worth, let's say, investing in terms of development and also making components, etc. But it doesn't mean that the same conclusion is valid forever and we might revisit our view and our position going forward.
"So we are, of course, humble, checking every solution that is out there, evaluate if there's anything interesting for us to pick up and keep this iterative process going forward."

Mercedes has managed without the wing so far. The team leads the constructors' championship on 578 points, 134 clear of Ferrari, and Kimi Antonelli is 102 points ahead of team-mate George Russell as they go into the race week of the United States Grand Prix.

The focus is, however, on bringing the new upgrade to both cars after it was previously split between the drivers in Singapore. Antonelli used the new upgrade while Russell tested the older version. Team principal Toto Wolff has since confirmed the new components will be seen on both cars at the American race.

detailZh: 兰多·诺里斯在病毒视频中出现，似乎在嘲笑拉恩斯·斯特罗尔引发争议
麦凯轮车手兰多·诺里斯在一段病毒视频中似乎在拿拉恩斯·斯特罗尔开玩笑，引发了F1粉丝的讨论
赛车文化超越赛道。车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计和那些让赛车不仅仅是一项运动的故事
一段视频在社交媒体上流传，似乎显示兰多·诺里斯在新加坡大奖赛后的一个夜晚嘲笑拉恩斯·斯特罗尔。这段视频在X上已经观看超过三百万次。
视频是由粉丝账号MV3daily在比赛之夜发布的。视频中，可以看到迈凯轮车手与哈斯一级方程式车手Ollie 贝尔曼一起外出，人群中有人举着一个写着"给最佳车手"的牌子。
视频中，诺里斯大声喊道"兰斯在哪里，兰斯在哪里？"，许多F1粉丝认为这是对阿斯顿·马丁车手的讽刺。
斯特罗尔本赛季还没有得分，今年成为首位达到100次Q1淘汰的车手。
分享视频的账号在其帖子中对诺里斯进行了批评。MV3daily写道："兰斯可能不是赛道上最好的车手，但至少要有一些尊严。"
在撰写本文时，该帖子已有330万次观看，约19,000个赞和564条回复。其中一条回复获得了超过5,000个赞，开玩笑说：“兄弟们的公关经理正在为他们的生命而战” [原文如此]。
辩论变得非常激烈，以至于后来账号要求粉丝冷静下来。
“我们能不能都放松一点，这里每个人都太过于激进，这都表现出来了，”MV3daily在第二天发布了以下内容。
诺里斯和斯特罗尔都没有对这段视频做出回应。
视频出现在世界冠军艰难周末的结尾。在周六的冲刺赛中，诺里斯和他的队友奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂在最后一圈的5号弯道发生碰撞，争夺第四名。皮亚斯蒂退赛，而诺里斯恢复到第八名，因此麦凯轮车队在红牛车队逼近车队 constructors' championship 第三名的时候只得到了一分。
诺里斯在随后的周日承认说：“这是我的错误，我让团队失望了。我也向他们所有人道歉，我欠他们一个道歉，我下次会做得更好。”
诺里斯以第四名的成绩完成了大奖赛，落后获胜者马克斯·维斯塔潘40.5秒。诺里斯现在在积分榜上排名第六，积分为201分，而麦凯轮车队在车队 constructors' championship 中领先红牛车队七分，前往德克萨斯州。
下一场比赛是10月23日至25日在奥斯汀举行的美国大奖赛。
detailEn: Lando Norris sparks controversy after appearing to mock Lance Stroll in viral video
The McLaren driver has sparked debate among F1 fans after a viral video shows what appeared to be him making a joke at Lance Stroll's expense
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.

A video is doing the rounds on social media, appearing to show Lando Norris mocking Lance Stroll on a night out after the Singapore Grand Prix. It's now been viewed more than three million times on X.

The clip was posted by the fan account MV3daily on the night of the race. In it, the McLaren driver is seen out with Haas Formula 1 driver Ollie Bearman while someone in the crowd raises a sign saying "To the best driver".
In the footage, Norris shouts "Where's Lance, where's Lance?", which many F1 fans took as a dig at the Aston Martin driver.
Stroll has yet to score a point this season and this year became the first driver to reach 100 Q1 eliminations.
The account that shared the video was critical of Norris in its post. "Lance may not be the best driver on the grid but have some decency atleast," MV3daily wrote.
At the time of writing, the post had 3.3 million views, around 19,000 likes and 564 replies. One reply, with more than 5,000 likes, joked: "bros PR manager is fighting for their life" [sic].
The debate became heated enough that the account later asked followers to calm down.
"Can we all relax a little bit, everyone is a little bit too aggressive on here and it's showing," MV3daily posted the following day.
Neither Norris nor Stroll has responded to the clip.

The video came at the end of a difficult weekend for the reigning world champion. In Saturday's sprint, Norris and team-mate Oscar Piastri were fighting for fourth when they collided at Turn 5 on the last lap. Piastri retired while Norris recovered to eighth, so McLaren left with one point at a time when Red Bull is closing in on third place in the constructors' championship.
"It was a mistake on my part, and I let down the team. I've also apologised to all of them, I owe them all an apology, and I will do better next time," Norris conceded on the following Sunday.

Norris finished the grand prix fourth, 40.5 seconds behind winner Max Verstappen. Norris now sits sixth in the standings on 201 points, and McLaren heads to Texas just seven points ahead of Red Bull in the constructors' championship.
The next race is the United States Grand Prix in Austin, from 23 to 25 October.

detailZh: 尼克·蒂姆调侃F1：“马克斯·维斯塔潘只想开一辆真正的赛车！”
GT3明星车手回应维斯塔潘在波尔蒂芒3小时赛中的意外亮相
阿斯顿·马丁老将尼克·蒂姆借马克斯·维斯塔潘在GT世界挑战赛欧洲杯波尔蒂芒收官战中的客串亮相，对F1进行了一番调侃。
F1在2026年动力单元规则上的困境已被广泛报道，该规则要求内燃机与电力各占50%的动力分配，而2027年及以后的规则调整也已列入计划。
然而就目前而言，F1必须忍受针对这些赛车的调侃，而维斯塔潘本人正是批评得最激烈的人之一。
蒂姆驾驶与马蒂亚·德鲁迪和罗斯·冈恩共享的7号Comtoyou Racing阿斯顿·马丁Vantage GT3赛车，排位赛获得第九名，他将对F1的抨击融入对这位四届世界冠军的高度赞扬之中。
“显然，他能来这里真是太棒了。我喜欢他的赛车心态——他就是想出去比赛，不惜一切代价，无论手里拿到什么车，”这位丹麦人说道。
“他大概是想开一辆真正的赛车，而不是他一直开着转悠的那些电动车！”
他能来参加最后一轮比赛真是太好了，显然这对我们所有人都有好处。我预计会有很多年轻人非常感兴趣并密切关注。
以这样的赛道结束赛季真是太棒了，而且显然我们自己还要为年度亚军的位置而战，所以一场重要的比赛即将到来。
整个围场里，车手和车队人员都表达了同样的看法，欢迎维斯塔潘的参赛为GTWC欧洲赛带来的前所未有的关注——这项赛事本就以高水平的职业GT3竞争和激烈比赛而闻名，但一直难以吸引主流关注。
宝马厂队车手乔丹·佩珀与谢尔顿·范德林德和查尔斯·维茨一同驾驶32号WRT宝马M4 GT3 Evo赛车，从第14位起步，他也表达了类似的赞赏。
这位南非车手表示：“我非常尊重马克斯。他来这里和我们一起参加GT世界赛，其实没什么可获得的。这也恰恰说明了我们所处的水平。”
“在我看来，无论他参加什么赛事，他都是我们这一代中最优秀的。他在纽博格林今年的表现就证明了这一点。”
“但他能利用一个空闲周末来参加GT赛事，并让我们这里的比赛获得真正的关注，这真的很酷。这个系列赛每年都在不断壮大。就在你觉得它已经不能再好的时候，竞争却变得更加激烈。”
波尔蒂芒的三小时比赛定于当地时间周六下午5点开始，届时将有61辆GT3赛车组成的参赛阵容角逐赛季收官战。
detailEn: Nicki Thiim's cheeky F1 jab: "Max Verstappen just wants to drive a proper race car!"
GT3 stars react to Verstappen's surprise appearance in the Portimao 3 Hours
Aston Martin veteran Nicki Thiim has used Max Verstappen’s guest appearance at the GT World Challenge Europe season finale in Portimao to take a cheeky jab at Formula 1.

F1's struggles with its 2026 power unit regulations, featuring a 50:50 power split between the internal combustion engine and electric power, have been well documented, with rule changes already planned for 2027 and beyond.
For now, however, F1 must endure the banter directed at the cars, which Verstappen himself has been among the most vocal in criticising.
Thiim, who qualified ninth in the #7 Comtoyou Racing Aston Martin Vantage GT3 he shares with Mattia Drudi and Ross Gunn, blended his F1 swipe into high praise for the four-time world champion.
"Obviously, it's super nice that he's here. I love his racing mindset - he just wants to go out there and race whatever it takes, whatever he gets his hands on," the Dane said.
"He probably wants to race a proper race car, not those electric things that he's been running around with!"
"It's super nice to have him here for the final round, and obviously it's good for all of us. I expect a lot of young people will be super interested and watch it closely.
"What a track to end the season on, and obviously we have a position to fight for second place in the championship ourselves, so an important race is coming up."

Across the paddock, drivers and team personnel echoed the sentiment, welcoming the unprecedented spotlight Verstappen’s entry brings to GTWC Europe - a championship already renowned for its high level of professional GT3 competition and fierce racing, but which has struggled to attract mainstream interest.
BMW factory driver Jordan Pepper, who starts 14th in the #32 WRT BMW M4 GT3 Evo alongside Sheldon van der Linde and Charles Weerts, shared similar praise.
"I have huge respect for Max. He's really got nothing to gain here, coming to play with us in GT World. It also just shows the level that we're at," the South African said.
"In my opinion, he's the best of our generation, no matter what he jumps into. He showed that at the Nurburgring with what he did this year.

"But it's just really cool that he's taking an off weekend, coming to GT, and putting a real spotlight on what we have here. The series goes from strength to strength every year. Just when you think it can't get any better, the competition gets even higher."
The three-hour race at Portimao is scheduled to start on Saturday at 5:00 PM local time, with a 61-car GT3 grid set to tackle the season finale.

detailZh: 红牛解释了AI如何影响其F1赛事策略
红牛透露，与Oracle合作开发的AI驱动的赛事策略工具正在帮助车队在大奖赛期间做出决策。
查尔斯·勒克莱尔、法拉利、马克斯·维斯塔潘、红牛车队
对于红牛车迷来说，关注红牛车队，了解F1新闻、车手更新、技术洞察和米尔顿凯恩斯的赛事分析。
红牛车队正在使用一套人工智能系统，在大奖赛期间为车队提供行动建议。
在CNBC的一次采访中，红牛技术及性能合作伙伴负责人杰克·哈林顿解释说，该工具是与头号合作伙伴甲骨文共同开发的。
这个工具最初是一个搜索工具，帮助工程师解读F1的规则和过去的裁决，现在已经发展成为一个"代理"人工智能，它利用更多信息并在比赛中提供行动建议。
哈林顿解释说："它实际上在为我们做决策。"
Oracle和红牛车队在2026年2月宣布了他们之间多年冠军合作伙伴关系的延长。米尔顿凯恩斯的车队在当时发布的新闻稿中解释说："延长的合作伙伴关系建立在车队传统的基础上，Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)和Oracle AI支撑着红牛福特动力系统下一代混合动力单元的2026年首秀，先进的赛车策略模拟和开创性的AI驱动策略代理。"
哈灵顿以2025年意大利大奖赛为例，展示了AI代理的工作方式。在蒙扎赛道比赛的第一个弯道，维斯塔潘在与麦克拉伦车队的兰多·诺里斯争夺领先时冲出了赛道。根据哈灵顿的说法，代理建议红牛车队放弃位置以避免处罚。
尽管这个建议与车队对局势的看法相悖，但红牛车队还是遵循了指示。维斯塔潘避免了处罚，很快从麦克拉伦车手那里夺回了领先，并以19.2秒的优势赢得了比赛。
哈灵顿补充说，"一级方程式赛车始终是人类的运动"，但他解释说，AI代理可以帮助提升车队。
红牛并非唯一使用人工智能的车队。谷歌正在与迈凯轮合作引入其Gemini人工智能工具，梅赛德斯与微软合作，法拉利则与IBM合作，为粉丝提供人工智能驱动的体验。
detailEn: Red Bull explains how AI is influencing its F1 race strategy
Red Bull has revealed how an AI-powered race strategy tool developed with Oracle is helping the F1 team make decisions during grands prix
Charles Leclerc, Ferrari, Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing
For Red Bull fans. Keeping watch on Red Bull Racing, with F1 news, driver updates, technical insight and race analysis from Milton Keynes.
Red Bull is using an artificial intelligence system that recommends actions to the team during a grand prix.
During an interview with CNBC, Red Bull head of technical and performance partnerships Jack Harington explained that the team built the tool with its title partner, Oracle.
What began as a search tool to help engineers interpret F1's regulations and past rulings has since become an "agentic" AI that draws on more information and recommends actions during a race.
"It’s actually making decisions for us," Harington explained.

Oracle and Red Bull announced a multi-year extension of their title partnership in February 2026. The Milton Keynes outfit explained in the press release at the time: "The extended partnership builds on the team’s legacy, with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) and Oracle AI underpinning the 2026 debut of Red Bull Ford Powertrains’ next-generation hybrid power unit, advanced race-strategy simulations, and a pioneering AI-powered strategy agent."

Harington used the example of the 2025 Italian Grand Prix to show how the AI agent works. On the opening lap of the race at Monza, Verstappen went off at the first chicane while fighting McLaren's Lando Norris for the lead. According to Harington, the agent advised Red Bull to hand the place back to avoid a penalty.

While that recommendation went against the team's view of the situation, Red Bull followed the instruction. Verstappen escaped a penalty, soon retook the lead from the McLaren driver and won the race by 19.2 seconds.
Harington added that "Formula 1 is and will always be a human sport", but explained that the AI agent can help enhance the team.

Red Bull is not the only team using AI. Google is working with McLaren to bring its Gemini AI tools, Mercedes has partnered with Microsoft and Ferrari is working with IBM on AI-powered experiences for fans.

detailEn: Max Verstappen unveils special Texas-themed helmet for F1 United States GP
Max Verstappen has unveiled a special Texas-themed helmet for the United States Grand Prix
For Red Bull fans. Keeping watch on Red Bull Racing, with F1 news, driver updates, technical insight and race analysis from Milton Keynes.

Four-time Formula 1 champion Max Verstappen has revealed a special helmet for the United States Grand Prix, giving his usual design an Austin, Texas, makeover ahead of the race at the Circuit of the Americas.
The Dutchman unveiled the new design on social media. "Texas bound. I’ll be coming to Austin with this special helmet!" he posted alongside detailed photos of the new helmet.

The main change is to the lion on the top of the helmet, which now wears a cowboy hat. The lion stands out in blue on a white background and the red, white and blue theme has been retained throughout the whole helmet.

At the time of writing, Verstappen's post had already received more than 747,000 likes. "10s across the board - the lion with the cowboy hat is incredible," one fan commented, while another added: "The lion in the cowboy hat is brilliant haha."
Further reactions included: "Oh this is gorgeous", and "Simply lovely that helmet."

To complement the new helmet, Verstappen and his Red Bull team-mate Isack Hadjar will also be wearing special all-white, vintage-style race suits. The new designs have sparked hope among fans that the Milton Keynes outfit could introduce an all-white livery for the race in Austin, but this is yet to be confirmed.

Verstappen heads to Austin after back-to-back wins at the Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia and the Singapore Grand Prix. He currently sits fourth in the drivers' standings with 221 points, 119 points behind championship leader Kimi Antonelli.

But while most drivers have a weekend off from racing after an intense triple-header, Verstappen is racing in the GT World Challenge Europe finale at Portimao this weekend in the Verstappen Racing #3 Mercedes-AMG with Chris Lulham and Ben Barnicoat.

The United States Grand Prix takes place at the Circuit of the Americas from 23-25 October and kicks off the next triple-header in the championship, with the Mexican and Brazilian Grands Prix in the two weeks following.

对于麦凯轮车迷来说，来自沃金克的新闻，有关车手、赛车、团队策略以及每个周末的每一场比赛的最新消息
麦凯轮车队负责人安德烈亚·斯特拉表示，车队仍在与兰多·诺里斯和奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里就他们在新加坡大奖赛冲刺阶段末尾的碰撞进行沟通。扎克·布朗对他们并没有那么宽容。
在冲刺赛最后一圈，这些像黄梨一样颜色的队友们正在为第四名而战，当诺里斯在5号弯从内线超车皮亚斯特里时。这是冠军车手的一次大胆举动——自从那时起，评论员们就对这一举动提出了批评。这导致了两辆赛车打滑，皮亚斯特里退赛。诺里斯恢复到第八名，裁判没有采取进一步行动。
在周日的大奖赛之后，斯特拉表示，讨论的内容不是关于谁应该承担责任，而是从中得到了什么。
“我们正在进行的对话还没有结束，但这并不是因为我们需要回去讨论兰多是否在奥斯卡旁边——那不是有趣的部分，”他说。
“对我来说，有趣的部分是所有利益相关者、车队、车手必须围绕如何共同领导团队、始终在驾驶舱内将团队的利益视为高于任何个人利益的反思，以及为什么从这个角度来看，对话还没有结束，我们还有更多可以做的事情来成为一个更加团结和强大的团队。”
麦克拉伦赛车公司的首席执行官在与天空体育F1的马丁·布伦德尔交谈时，并没有像他的F1车队总监那样随和。
“哦，是的。那是‘别再这样做’。我们并没有说请，这是命令。”布朗说。
当车队面临很大压力时，这是不必要的后果，我们正在试图追赶法拉利，而红牛车队也不远。
奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里，麦克拉伦，兰多·诺里斯，麦克拉伦
在冲刺赛后，诺里斯为这次行动进行了辩护，说“那是一个很大的差距，我冲了出去，我有权这么做”，但到了周日晚上，他对这次行动的看法已经改变了。
“我不能尝试我做的事情，我一开始就不应该尝试，即使这个动作是允许的。我必须更多地考虑我代表的团队，而不是我自己。这是我的错误，我让团队失望了。我也向他们所有人道歉了，我欠他们一个道歉，我们下次会做得更好。”
诺里斯以第四名的成绩完成了大奖赛，皮亚斯特里以第五名的成绩落后于他。
梅赛德斯车队在车队积分榜上排名第三，积339分，落后法拉利105分，仅领先红牛车队7分。奥斯汀的美国大奖赛将见证车队之间的激烈竞争。
detailEn: Zak Brown gives stern warning to Lando Norris and Oscar Piastri after Singapore collision
McLaren's team principal also wants both drivers to put the team first after their Singapore sprint collision, with Red Bull now just seven points behind
For McLaren fans. Papaya news from Woking, with the latest on the drivers, the car, team strategy and every race weekend.

McLaren team principal Andrea Stella says the team is still talking to Lando Norris and Oscar Piastri after their collision towards the end of the Singapore Grand Prix sprint. Zak Brown wasn't as easy on them.

The papaya-coloured team-mates were fighting for fourth on the last lap of the sprint when Norris dived up the inside of Piastri at Turn 5. It was a bullish move from the reigning champion - and one that has come under criticism from pundits since. It resulted in both cars spinning and Piastri's retirement. Norris recovered to eighth and the stewards took no further action.
Speaking after Sunday's grand prix, Stella said that the discussions were not about who was to blame, but instead what came from it.
“The conversations that we are having they are not finished, but it's not because we need to go back discussing if Lando was alongside Oscar – that's not the interesting bit," he said.

“For me, the interesting bit is a reflection that all the stakeholders, the team, the drivers will have to make around leading together the team, embracing constantly from inside the cockpit the interest of the team as something that is superior to any particular singular individual interest, and why the conversations from this point of view they are not concluded, and there's more we can do to become a more united and even stronger team.”
The McLaren Racing CEO wasn't as easygoing as his F1 team chief as he talked to Sky Sports F1's Martin Brundle on his grand prix grid walk.
"Oh yeah. That was a 'don't do that again'. And we didn't say please. That's an order," Brown said.
"It was an unnecessary result for the team when a lot of pressure is on, and we're trying to catch Ferrari and Red Bull's not far behind."
Oscar Piastri, McLaren, Lando Norris, McLaren
Immediately after the sprint, Norris defended the move, saying "it was a big gap, I went for it, I have the right to do that", but, by the end of Sunday, his feelings had changed on the move.

"I can't attempt what I did, I should never have attempted it in the first place, even if the move was on. I simply have to think more about the team that I represent more than myself. It was a mistake on my part, I let down the team. I've also apologised to all of them and I owe them all an apology and we'll do better next time."
Norris finished the grand prix fourth, with Piastri finishing behind him in fifth.

McLaren is third in the constructors' standings on 339 points, 105 behind Ferrari and only seven ahead of Red Bull. The United States Grand Prix in Austin will see the tight fight between the teams continue.

detailZh: 克里斯蒂安·霍纳呼吁重新审视F1预算帽：“车队每年要花5亿到6亿美元”
F1自2021年起实行预算帽，目前上限为2.15亿美元，另加其他支出
克里斯蒂安·霍纳呼吁F1提高2.15亿美元的预算帽，称“车队每年要花5亿到6亿美元”。
自2021年起，F1实行预算帽制度，限制车队每赛季的支出，上限从1.45亿美元起步，最终提高到2.15亿美元。
但这2.15亿美元并不涵盖F1车队的每一项开支，因为车手合同、非车手收入前三名员工的薪资、差旅费用和营销支出都不包括在内。
还有许多其他方面未被纳入，同时还有一项单独的1.9亿美元动力单元预算上限，这意味着在车队估值屡创新高的情况下，成本依然高得惊人。
因此，霍纳——其前东家红牛车队曾超出2021年预算上限5%，从而被罚款700万美元并削减10%的风洞和CFD测试时间——敦促F1重新审视这一制度。
“最初几年，各队还在适应这些规则，”他告诉《汽车运动》。“我们第一年因此受罚的那些事情，放到现在根本不算问题，甚至第二年也不会是问题。”
“所以我认为他们已经把很多规则都绑定了，我现在看到的是，预算帽略高于2亿美元，但车队却花了5亿或6亿美元。
“预算帽里需要纳入更多东西。我认为引擎方面的上限，可以说，作为一个包罗万象的上限，是件好事，问题只是这个水平定在哪里？
“F1车队有多少钱就会花多少钱，这就像一个气不够的气球，你挤一头，气就会跑到别处去。
“所以你现在会看到车手保留金比预算帽之前健康得多，关键是要找到那个正确的平衡，我认为现在所有这些业务都不再是负债了。
“即便是发车区上最小的车队，估值也达到数十亿美元。五六七年前，它们还会被视为负债。”
“因此，这为这些车队或特许经营权注入了真正的价值，像哈斯或威廉姆斯这样的车队排名也上升了。”
但威廉姆斯对预算帽仍不太满意，因为车队领队詹姆斯·沃尔斯本月声称，领先车队从中获益比发车区其他车队更多。
这位英国人认为，他的车队在赛车和人员成本上的支出受到限制，因为它将这笔钱用于资本支出，而资本支出属于预算帽范围。
然而，红牛、梅赛德斯和法拉利等车队在预算帽实施前已经斥巨资建设世界级设施，所以现在它们可以直接把那2.15亿美元投入到赛道上的投资中。
尽管如此，预算帽仍然给F1带来了巨大的积极影响，车队比以往任何时候都更加稳定，考虑到印度力量是2018年最后一支进入破产管理的车队。
“在那之前，F1就像是一个底部有洞的装满钱的桶，”霍纳补充道。
“你会尽可能跑得远，直到钱用完，并且花费比实际拥有的多一点。结果我们看到许多车队来来去去，而现在有了预算帽，它推动了效率。
埃斯特班·奥康，印度力量车队，2018年西班牙大奖赛
“我记得预算帽之前，赛季结束时我们会有大量未使用的库存，那些零件从未见过赛车，价值数千万英镑。
“我们会有这些是因为知识产权，你不想让它流到外面，你也不会销毁它，所以它们就堆在仓库里，满是底板、尾翼和悬挂部件——有点像《印第安纳·琼斯：夺宝奇兵》里的场景！
“现在有了预算帽，你就没有这种奢侈了，所以你在制造什么、如何花钱、这些部件的使用和消耗方面要精挑细选得多。
“这确实提升了企业的效率，所以现在会计团队在赢得大奖赛方面与设计团队发挥着同样重要的作用。”
“到我离开的时候，会计部门的规模已经和绘图室一样大了，因为财务规则与体育规则或技术规则同样重要。”
detailEn: Christian Horner calls for F1 budget cap rethink: "Teams are spending $500 or $600m"
F1 has operated under a budget cap since 2021, currently valued at $215m plus other expenditures
Christian Horner has called on Formula 1 to increase the $215million budget cap, claiming “teams are spending $500 or $600million” year on year.
From 2021 the championship has operated under a budget cap system which limits how much a team can spend per season, with it starting at $145m before eventually increasing to $215m.
But that $215m doesn’t cover every single cost made by an F1 team, as driver contracts, the salaries of the top three non-driver earners, travel costs and marketing spend aren’t included.
There are many other aspects not included, whereas there is also a separate $190m power unit budget cap, meaning costs are still astronomically high amid record-breaking team values.
So Horner, whose former Red Bull squad breached the 2021 cap by 5%, thus receiving a $7m fine and 10% reduction in wind tunnel and CFD testing, has urged F1 to rethink the system.
“In the early years there was a bedding into those rules,” he told Autosport. “The things that we got charged with in that first year now would not be an issue, or even in the second year.
“So I think they've tied it up, a lot of the regulations, what I see now is that you've got a budget cap of just over $200m but teams are spending $500 or $600m.
“More needs to be included within the cap. I think the cap on the engine side, arguably, as an all-encompassing cap, is a good thing, it's just what is that level?
“Formula 1 teams will spend as much money as they have and it's like a balloon with not enough air in it, if you squeeze it one end, the air is going to go somewhere else.
“So you'll now see driver retainers far healthier than they were pre-budget cap and it's finding that right balance and I think all of these businesses now, they're no longer liabilities.
“Even the smallest team on the grid has a multi-billion dollar valuation. Five, six, seven years ago, they would have been seen as liabilities.
“So it's driven real value into these teams, or franchises, that a team like Haas or Williams has come up the rankings.”
But Williams is still not particularly happy with the budget cap, as team boss James Vowles claimed this month that the frontrunners benefit from it more than the rest of the grid.
The Briton reckons his team is limited on what it can spend on the car and personnel costs, because it is putting that money towards capital expenditure which falls under the cap.
Teams like Red Bull, Mercedes and Ferrari, however, had already spent heavily on world-class facilities before the cap, so now it can just put that $215m straight into on-track investment.
Despite that, the budget cap has still brought vast positives to F1 with teams more stable than ever, considering Force India is the last constructor to have entered administration in 2018.
“Prior to that, Formula 1 was like having a bucket full of money with a hole in the bottom,” added Horner.
“You'd run as far as you could with it until it ran out and spend a bit more than you actually had. We saw many teams come and go as a result and now with a budget cap, it's driven efficiency.
Esteban Ocon, Force India, at 2018 Spanish GP
“I remember pre-budget cap, the amount of unused stock that we would have at the end of the season, that had never seen a racing car, it'd be tens of millions of pounds.

“We’d have because the IP, you don't want it to go anywhere, you're not going to destroy it, and so they just sit in warehouses full of floors and wings and suspension parts - something like out of an Indiana Jones, Raiders of the Lost Ark scenario!
“Now with a budget cap you don't have that luxury, so you're much more selective in what you manufacture, how you spend your money, the usage and the consumption of those parts.
“It’s driven a real efficiency into the businesses, so the accounts teams play as big a role as the design teams now in terms of winning grands prix.
“By the time I left, the accounting department was as big as the drawing office because the financial rules are as important as the sporting or technical rule.”

items.originalTitle: Jos Verstappen was hyped like Max - until it all went wrong
items.summaryEn: The article recalls how Jos Verstappen impressed in a Footwork test at Estoril in 1993, generating huge excitement and landing on the cover of Autosport magazine as 'F1's hottest new boy'.
detailZh: 乔斯·维斯塔潘自己在F1的失意，在多大程度上推动了他为儿子马克斯备战后来堪称现象级的F1生涯倾注一切，这已是赛车运动中的民间传说。
如今或许被忽视的一点是，乔斯自己的F1生涯本应有多出色——曾经有那么一段时间（诚然很短暂），人们对乔斯成为未来F1冠军的期待，与2015年马克斯进入F1发车格时一样热烈。
正如我们与埃德·斯特劳和马克·休斯合作的新一季F1 Rewind播客系列最新一集所探讨的，真正开启这波热潮的，是1993年9月底在埃斯托里尔为Footwork车队进行的一次测试。
当时乔斯离开卡丁车仅两年，刚刚赢得德国F3锦标赛冠军，21岁的他做出的圈速，若放在前一周葡萄牙大奖赛排位赛中，足以让他那辆非常平庸的赛车排在第10位。赛道状况的演变对他的圈速有所影响，但他的整体表现给人留下了巨大印象。维斯塔潘登上了下一周《Autosport》杂志的封面，该杂志称他为“F1最炙手可热的新人”。
埃德·斯特劳：“如果你看看乔斯·维斯塔潘的职业生涯记录，却没有亲身经历过，就很容易低估这次测试产生的巨大影响。”
马克·休斯：“他当时是备受追捧的抢手人物。他从卡丁车直接进入贝内卢克斯锦标赛的GM Lotus车队，并立即赢得冠军。他曾在斯帕赛道更高级别的GM Lotus系列赛中做过一次客串出场。那场比赛他表现惊艳。
“他直接升入三级方程式，赢得德国锦标赛，统治了赛场，看起来注定要在F1赛道上大放异彩。
“各支车队争相抢着要给他一份长期合同。如果你在寻找下一个迈克尔·舒马赫或米卡·哈基宁可能在哪里，那就是你要找的地方。毫无疑问。”
埃德·斯特劳：“基本上所有人都在和他谈。迈凯伦曾在某个阶段给他安排了一次测试。显然还有贝纳通，他最终签约的车队。甚至法拉利也有一点兴趣。那绝对是一场哄抢，因为这就是下一个超级巨星。
“也因为他的上升速度太快了。两年内从卡丁车到F1。近年来我们已经有点习惯非常快的晋升了，比如马克斯·维斯塔潘。但在那个时候，这真的非常非常罕见。
“所以你不仅拥有这位被认为不可思议的车手，而且他还坐着这艘火箭飞船直奔F1。
“如果在1993年底你问，‘好，谁将进入F1赢得比赛并成为未来的世界冠军？’约斯·维斯塔潘就是人们会挑出的名字。”
马克·休斯：“在那个时候绝对是压倒性的。毫无疑问。他正处于重大突破的边缘。”
维斯塔潘和经纪人胡布·罗滕加特选择了贝纳通车队，该车队提供1994年一个赛季的测试和准备工作，然后保证1995年的正式比赛席位——要么在自家车队，要么安排到其他地方。
但维斯塔潘并没有在聚光灯外获得一年的学习时间，而是当JJ·莱赫托在测试撞车中受伤后，他被推上了贝纳通的第二个比赛席位，与迈克尔·舒马赫并肩作战。
维斯塔潘最终在那个席位上两度登场，因为莱赫托回归后仍然挣扎，不得不再次退出，之后他在赛季末被按在替补席上，以便贝纳通评估约翰尼·赫伯特在那辆车上的表现。
这加起来是1994赛季16站中的10站，他驾驶第二辆贝纳通车队赛车，维斯塔潘两次登上领奖台，但也在巴西站首秀中被埃迪·欧文引发的一起连环事故送入一次令人恐惧的腾空撞车，还卷入了臭名昭著的德国大奖赛维修区火灾。
后来他承认，那辆以舒马赫为中心的赛车对他来说“过于敏感”，在他们共同出战的八场比赛中，维斯塔潘从未在排位赛中击败舒马赫，甚至从未在比赛圈结束时领先过舒马赫，平均差距高达1.920秒（2.288%）。
作为准备不足的新秀，在同一车队中与舒马赫对抗，又处在一个动荡的赛季中，这是一项艰巨的任务。而这足以瞬间粉碎维斯塔潘带入F1的所有职业势头和炒作。
马克·休斯：“事后看来，他还没准备好，他来得太早了。如果最初的计划得以实施，他本会在远离大奖赛聚光灯的地方积累大量里程，并且可能在1995年准备得充分得多地到来。
“不仅如此，贝纳通车队完全是以迈克尔·舒马赫为中心，而车队老板弗拉维奥·布里亚托雷则涉足车手管理，然后靠车手赚钱。
“罗滕加特和维斯塔潘在不知不觉中交出了对自己命运的控制权。维斯塔潘不仅在一支完全围绕一名车手打造的车队里开着实质上只是第二梯队的赛车，他甚至都无法掌控自己下一步要去哪里。”
埃德·斯特劳：“他经历了这样一个奇怪的赛季，实际上那第一赛季就抹掉了他职业生涯势头的很大一部分。确实如此，真的真的如此。势头并没有完全消失，还残留着一点‘哦这家伙不错’的印象，但基本上大局已定。”
马克·休斯：“当你陷入那种境地——你是二号车手，不是任何事情的焦点——这会消耗你的精力。而你此前一直习惯于处在一切事物的绝对中心，习惯于被当作一颗正在冉冉升起的巨星来对待，在青训车队里一切都围绕着你，所有人都为你而来，所有人都站在你这边。突然之间沦为一个跟班的角色，我认为这确实会对你造成伤害。
“不仅如此，你还要作为一名新秀去对抗迈克尔·舒马赫。
“而在后来更能反思的岁月里，维斯塔潘也说，即使不考虑装备差异——贝纳通当时确实存在显著的装备差异——即使不考虑所有对他不利的因素，当你近距离看到迈克尔能够做到的一些事情时，你突然不得不对自己说：‘我进来时以为我会赢比赛，我以为我会赢冠军，我会打败所有人’，然后你遇到那样一个人，你会想：‘不，也许我得在这里重新校准。’
“甚至维斯塔潘也承认，也许他并不是迈克尔·舒马赫。
“但他相当出色。比他后来能够展现出来的还要好。”
观看或收听《F1 Rewind》节目，了解更多关于乔斯（Jos）的F1职业生涯，包括后来错失的重大机会，并深入探讨这一切如何影响了他对马克斯（Max）的养育方式以及马克斯通往F1的旅程。
detailEn: The degree to which Jos Verstappen’s own Formula 1 disappointment fuelled everything he poured into son Max’s preparation for his ultimately-phenomenal F1 career is already part of motorsport folklore.

The element that perhaps gets overlooked now is how good Jos’s own F1 career was supposed to be - that there was a period, a short one admittedly, when there was just as much excitement over Jos’s prospects as a future F1 champion as there was over Max’s arrival on the F1 grid in 2015.
As the latest episode of our new F1 Rewind podcast series with Edd Straw and Mark Hughes explores, it’s a test for Footwork at Estoril in late September 1993 that really starts the hype.

Only two years out of karting, and having just won the German Formula 3 title, 21-year-old Jos sets a time that would’ve put his very middling car 10th on the grid for the previous weekend’s Portuguese Grand Prix. Track evolution played a part in his time, but the impression his overall performance makes is huge. Verstappen gets the cover slot on the next week’s Autosport magazine, which declares him ‘F1’s hottest new boy’.
Edd Straw: “If you look at Jos Verstappen's career record and didn't experience it or live through it, it's really easy to underestimate how big an impact this test really made."

Mark Hughes: “He was a seriously hot property at that time. He came straight in from karting and won championship immediately in GM Lotus in the Benelux Championship. He'd done a one-off guest appearance in the bigger league GM Lotus series at Spa. He was sensational in that.
“He moved straight to Formula 3, won the German championship, dominated it, and looked set to set the F1 tracks alight.

“The teams were falling over themselves trying to get him on a long-term contract. If you were looking for where the next Michael Schumacher or Mika Hakkinen might be, that's where you are looking. No question.”

Edd Straw: “Everybody was talking to him basically. McLaren gave him a test at one stage. Obviously Benetton, who he eventually signed for. There was a little bit of Ferrari interest even. It was an absolute clamour because this was the next mega-star.

“Also because of how rapid his ascent was. Karting to F1 in two years. In recent years we’ve got a bit more used to really fast ascents, such as Max Verstappen’s. But that was really, really rare at this point.
“So you've not only got this driver who is considered to be incredible, but he's on this rocketship to F1 as well.
“And if in late 1993 you were saying, ‘right, who is going to come into F1 and win races and be a future world champion?’ Jos Verstappen is the name people would have picked out.”
Mark Hughes: “Overwhelmingly at that time. There was no question. He was on the verge of something big.”

Verstappen and manager Huub Rothengatter pick Benetton, which is offering a season of testing and preparation in 1994 then a guaranteed race seat - either in its own squad, or placed elsewhere - for 1995.
But rather than getting a year of learning outside the spotlight, Verstappen is thrust into Benetton’s second race seat alongside Michael Schumacher when JJ Lehto is injured in a testing crash.

Verstappen ultimately gets two stints in that seat, with Lehto still struggling on his return and having to step away again, before being benched at the end of the season so Benetton can evaluate Johnny Herbert in that car.

It adds up to 10 of the 16 1994 rounds in the second Benetton, with Verstappen earning two podiums, but also being sent into a terrifying aerial crash on his debut in Brazil in a pile-up triggered by Eddie Irvine and being caught up in the infamous German GP pit fire.

Later admitting he found the Schumacher-centric car “too nervous” for him, Verstappen never outqualified or even once led Schumacher at the end of a racing lap in their eight outings together with a massive 1.920s (2.288%) average deficit.

Going up against Schumacher in the same team as an underprepared rookie, amid a season of turmoil, was a tall order. And it was enough to instantly crush all that career momentum and hype Verstappen had carried into F1.

Mark Hughes: “In hindsight, he wasn't ready, he came in too early. Had the original plan played out, he would have been getting a lot of mileage away from the spotlight of grands prix and would have probably come in much better prepared in 1995.
“Not only that, Benetton was absolutely centred around Michael Schumacher and team boss Flavio Briatore was into driver management and then making money on drivers.

“Rothengatter and Verstappen had unknowingly surrendered control of his own destiny. As well as being in essentially just the second string car in a team that was totally focused around one driver, Verstappen wasn't even going to be in charge of where he was going to go next.”

Edd Straw: “He has this weird season and actually a big chunk of that career momentum's wiped out by that first season. It really, really is. It's not gone. There's still a residual, ‘oh this guy's good’, but already pretty much the die is cast.”

Mark Hughes: “It saps you of energy when you get into a situation like that where you're the second driver and you're not the focus of anything. And you've been used to being at the absolute centre of everything. You've been used to being treated as a megastar in the making and with everything centred around you in the junior category, with everybody there for you, everybody on your side. And suddenly to be in the lackey role, I think it does damage you.
“And not only that, but you're going up against Michael Schumacher as a rookie.

“And in his more reflective later years, Verstappen also said that even disregarding the equipment differences - and there were significant equipment differences at Benetton - and even disregarding all the factors against him, when you looked at some of the things that Michael was able to do close up and suddenly have to say to yourself, ‘I came in thinking I was going to win races, I think I'm going to win the championship, I'm going to beat everybody’ and then you come up against somebody like that and you think, ‘no, maybe I have to recalibrate here’.
“And even Verstappen acknowledges that maybe he wasn't Michael Schumacher.
“But he was pretty good. Better than he was able to show subsequently.”

Watch or listen to F1 Rewind for much more on Jos’s F1 career, including the later big opportunities that fell through, and an in-depth look at how it all fed into the way he handled Max’s upbringing and journey towards F1.
